wholeCurrentGoal.title: Biologische und kulturelle Evolution des Menschen rekonstruieren
wholeCurrentGoal.titleEn: Reconstruct Biological and Cultural Human Evolution
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann aus Merkmalen fossiler Funde Hypothesen zur biologischen Evolution des modernen Menschen ableiten, eine zeitliche Reihenfolge rekonstruieren und die Bedeutung kultureller Evolution für den heutigen Menschen analysieren.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can derive hypotheses about biological human evolution from fossil traits, reconstruct a chronological sequence, and analyze the importance of cultural evolution for humans today.

ownSpecificObservations: The original foreground book is now physically closed with a blank pale cover and visible page block. There is no open page diagram, left-to-right sequence or external-viewer-facing reading entry, so the actor-perspective fault is absent.

The teaching/learning interaction remains concrete: the left adult points toward the tool held by the right adult, a speech bubble depicts that same tool, and knowledge through learning/transmission is readable. The closed book is a present-day generic teaching prop, not a reconstructed prehistoric object.

The fossil fragment/relative chronological cue and uncertain branched hypotheses retain their original didactic purpose. No absolute dates or fossil taxon names are introduced. No march-of-progress or acquired-knowledge-DNA path is drawn.

At 360 and 680 px, the three panels, fossil fragments, uncertain graph, speech/tool demonstration and closed cover remain distinct. Small supplementary sentences are secondary to the major visual actions, and there is no reading exercise in a tiny entry.
